$comment: A LOWERCASE clsbox, and the same device as valid/lorastats-production-canonical.json (04B64810652B) written the other way. VALID on purpose: envelope-v1.schema.json is ^[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}$ and stays that way, because 400-ing a real measurement over hex case would be the netstats ip/gw/mask/dns mistake again (claude/CLAUDE.md §6). What this fixture guards is what happens NEXT: the Writer uppercases clsbox before the INSERT and V5's CHECK enforces it, so both spellings land on ONE key in idx_lorastats_tenant_clsbox_device_uid (DL-115). Before that change every clsbox in this directory was uppercase, so nothing here could catch the split key -- and the symptom is a silently partial 200 from the clsbox filter, not an error.
